4990.title: Async choice metadata is lost during provider translation
4990.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex adapter rebuilds async assistant messages as text-only deltas and has no durable async question interaction path.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed unmerged proposal spans shared contracts and async lifecycle handling; its branch was not executed.

4990.proposedFix: Validate the current async provider payload, then implement durable question lifecycle and active/idle answer routing across provider, runtime, and server contracts.
4990.caveats: Synthesized async metadata fails identically in two clean trusted checkouts; actual Codex 0.160.1 payload and desktop UI were not verified. Chrome was unavailable. No safe simple PR because a complete fix spans shared interaction/protocol boundaries.
